item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02290","case1_error":"Uses doubled two-week vegetable consumption as weekly consumption, then adds one week's kale.","case2_error":"Calculates unripe peaches using the original total of 18, failing to remove the three eaten peaches.","reason":"The first mixes time periods; the second uses an outdated total after removal.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02291","case1_error":"Reports the shortened component length, 5 inches, instead of the combined length of three tied pieces, 15 inches.","case2_error":"Excludes Nicole when averaging the oldest sister's three younger sisters' clothing.","reason":"The first answers a component-length quantity; the second forms an average over the wrong set of people.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02292","case1_error":"Uses the old monthly salary for the new company, ignoring the 20% raise.","case2_error":"Reports net spending of $23 as money remaining, instead of subtracting it from $74.","reason":"The first omits a specified salary adjustment; the second answers spending rather than the requested remaining balance.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02293","case1_error":"Treats current fuel as full capacity, then subtracts only the truck's current fuel to calculate the amount needed.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correctly written subtraction 418 − 342 as 67 instead of 76.","reason":"The first constructs erroneous relations for fuel needed; the second makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02294","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 30 + 35 + 46 as 101 instead of 111.","case2_error":"Invents a dryer-sheet gift, adds it to usage, misuses box price as per-sheet cost, and supplies unsupported final numbers.","reason":"The first is arithmetic evaluation of a correct expression; the second contains incorrect premises and savings relations, followed by unsupported numbers.","judgment":"different"}]}
